# PDFora

> PDFora is a free online toolkit for PDF document tasks, calculators, text and developer utilities, image tools, SEO checks, and Nepal-focused utilities.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/): Overview of PDFora and featured tools.
- [All tools](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/tools): Searchable directory of available tools.
- [Nepali home](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/ne): Reviewed Nepali-language overview and selected localized tools.
- [Nepali tools](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/ne/tools): Directory of published Nepali tools.
- [How to use PDFora](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/how-to-use): Product walkthrough and usage guidance.
- [Blog](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/blog): Practical guides and tutorials.
- [Market tools](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/market): Nepal market information tools; check source timestamps and freshness.
- [NEPSE Lab](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/nepse-lab): Educational technical-analysis utilities and historical market context.
- [About](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/about): Information about PDFora.
- [Privacy policy](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/privacy): File handling and privacy information.
- [Terms](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/terms): Terms of use.
- [Contact](https://pd-fora.vercel.app/contact): Contact information.

## Important usage and privacy notes

- PDFora tools have different processing methods. Some process files in the browser; other workflows may send files to the PDFora processing service. Users should read the notice on each tool and the privacy policy before uploading sensitive documents.
- Calculators and market utilities provide informational estimates, not professional financial, legal, tax, or investment advice.
- Market information can be delayed or unavailable. Always check the displayed source and update time.
- OCR is not currently available as a working PDF service; do not describe it as an active capability.
- Tool availability, supported formats, file limits, and features can change. Refer to the individual tool page for current details.
